assumption: Only plant-level 'Machine Power' (kWh/day) is metered (CFS/utility power is excluded as it is not attributable to individual lines). Daily plant Machine Power is allocated across the 26 production lines active that day using a weighted blend of three normalized shares: 40% runtime-hours share (Availability% x standard available hours/day), 35% production-quantity share (Actual units produced), and 25% OEE share (OEE% as a proxy for equipment load/intensity). This is an engineering estimate, not sub-metered data, and should be replaced with real line-level meters as soon as they are available.
